notes.title: Pilots implemented and balance changes
notes.notes:
Pilot system implemented:

 Now you can choose between the 4 pilots to control your mech. Each one has pros and cons that will affect you playthrough.



Balance changes:

 Orbital weapons now deal more damage.
 Orbital powerups no longer appear in the same place as obstacles.


On the next patch:

 New maps

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Remove the lvl 10 limit on the orbitals, now you can lvl up them endlessly. Have fun
Bug fixed:
- 10% shop sale relic was not working when you locked a piece.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Endless mode unlocked after you beat the game once.
 2 new achievements.
 Drone damage info panel implemented.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.4
notes.notes:
-Coin amount gain balanced. In the later waves you gained too much.
-10 k enemies destroyed achievement fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
